hukhong.story.doc.a1: "The waning night will be whole again." Those who feel a piece of their life is missing, come claim it from the Night Hall. Bring sincerity, not your true name.
hukhong.story.doc.a2: Directive to the Shadow Line: unlock the Hắc Thạch Pass city defense formation before the moon cycle. Let no one see your true face.
hukhong.story.doc.a3: Secret report: Hống still believes he protects his tribe. Do not wake him. He does not know he is only a rebuilt shadow.
hukhong.story.doc.a4: Tribute ledger: the villages that delivered offerings to Hống over three moon seasons. The Void must feed, and it feeds regularly.
hukhong.story.doc.a5: A map of Viêm Sơn with a red circle around a cave amid the lava flows. A note in the margin: "Let no one go beyond this place."
hukhong.story.doc.a6: Letter in Dạ Khuyết's hand: "The Earth Gate needs only one person holding it in the right place. Bring that person, and I will handle the rest. The waning night will be whole again."
hukhong.story.doc.b1: Hymn of the Void Saint: "No more difference, no more pain." The infected chant this each night until they forget they were ever different from anyone.
hukhong.story.doc.b2: A list of "like-minded friends" inside the Radiant Daoist Palace, with their watch hours and the gates they guard. Two names have been crossed out.
hukhong.story.doc.b3: A diary of an Apostle: "The Saintess takes no side; she only wants everyone free of pain. Sometimes I wonder whom I am really following."
hukhong.story.doc.b4: Notes on the original: Bạch Từ Âm died healing the infected, not fighting. The one who stands in the temple now keeps only her compassion.
hukhong.story.doc.b5: The plan: use Dạ Khuyết as the Void's interpreter. The Void does not understand human speech, but it understands a god's fear of growing old.
hukhong.story.doc.b6: Dạ Khuyết's letter: "Ask the Saintess about the door. She will tell the truth." Beneath the signature, a crescent moon cut with one extra stroke.

hukhong.chg.line.1: This is the land of my kin. Whoever steps further is an enemy of blood and flesh.
hukhong.chg.line.2: Have you never wished for someone's pain to end?
hukhong.chg.line.3: A sword asks no name. Neither should you speak yours.
hukhong.chg.line.4: I smell on you the scent of one about to seek a god and demand answers.
hukhong.chg.fall.1: You are stronger than I... you will see in time.
hukhong.chg.fall.2: If pain is real, why do you still keep it?
hukhong.chg.fall.3: I dreamed always of a sword no one has drawn.
hukhong.chg.fall.4: Tell him: the waning night never becomes full.

hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.idle.p1: The road is long. I will keep watching the news from the cities.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1.p1: You saw it too? The man outside the gate... his name faded like mist.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1.p2: I am Mo Dao, a Dao cultivator. The Void is eating this world, one name at a time.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1.p3: Walk with me? At least until you are strong enough to stand alone.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1_lore.p1: Something beyond the Heavenly Dao: nameless, formless, only hungry. A thousand years ago it tore the Great Rift.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1_end.p1: Good. Enter the Dao and reach level 10. At Hac Thach Pass there is one of rare talent, worth meeting.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4_wait.p1: You have grown stronger. When a lair clue emerges (level 50), come find me.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4.p1: You traced a lair... Then I cannot hide it any longer.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4.p2: My parents were Emissaries of Da Khuyet. I grew up in the Night Hall as a child.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4.p3: I have opposed them for a long time. Do you still trust me?
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4_trust.p1: Thank you. The lairs of Thach Hong and Bach Tu Am lie within the clues you gathered. Follow them.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4_doubt.p1: I understand. Let deeds prove it. Follow the Executor lair clues.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.early.p1: You are too weak. Return at level 10 once you have met Mo Dao.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.p1: Hang Chieu. Remember the name; soon all the world will.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.p2: The Void-touched I cut down had sect tokens on them. The enemy is not outside; it is inside our own house.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.c1: Let us investigate together. I will not lose to you.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.c2: I will walk my own road.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2_end.p1: Hunt the Emissaries in the corrupted lands; they drop Van Kien. I hear the old archivist in Co Tien City knows more than he lets on.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.idle.p1: Do not let me leave you far behind.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.early.p1: A novice is not ready to hear old tales. Reach level 30 and bring two Van Kien.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.p1: Van Kien... you have read them. Then I will say it: a god opened the Night Gate with his own hand.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.p2: The four Executors are not the four Great Cultivators. They are copies the Void simulated; the originals died long ago.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.p3: Gather three Van Kien of one chain and a lair will reveal itself. Take this pill.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.c1: Thank you. I will follow the trail.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3_end.p1: At level 50, go back and tell Mo Dao what you found. She has something to say.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.idle.p1: So many books, so little time. Go.

hukhong.endgame.dakhuyet.appear.2: Da Khuyet: "The waning night will be whole again... if only you would stop resisting."

hukhong.endgame.choice.title: The Final Choice
hukhong.endgame.choice.once: Chosen once; engraved on your own Monument of Deeds.
hukhong.endgame.choice.seal.desc: Assemble the Heaven Gate and close the Void. The world finds peace, but the seal needs guarding. World Tier II: a bright world of Ancient Spirits and Fallen Gods.
hukhong.endgame.choice.absorb.desc: Swallow the Void into your divine core. You become the center of power, but alone. World Tier II: a purple-black world of tamed Void Spawn.
hukhong.endgame.tier2: World Tier II unlocked: mobs are stronger, rewards are greater.
hukhong.endgame.return.seal: The gate closes behind you. The world is quiet, yet something feels unfinished.
hukhong.endgame.return.absorb: The Void rests within you. People look at you with fear.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.title: SEAL
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.1: The four Shards ignite and join into the Heaven Gate.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.2: The Night Gate closes. Whatever remains inside stays there.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.3: The first dawn in three hundred years.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.title: ABSORB
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.1: The Void flows back into you, silent as water into sand.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.2: The Night Gate opens within your chest. No one speaks to you anymore.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.3: You are everything. And you are alone.

hukhong.endgame.credits.11: The waning night never turns whole
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5_wait.p1: Four Executors remain, and the road to level ninety-nine. Then I will show you the door.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.p1: The four Executors have fallen and you stand here at level ninety-nine. I never thought I would see this day.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.p2: A gate has opened near where you stood. Beyond lies the Primordial Void, where Primordial Oblivion dwells.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.p3: The Void is not evil; it only wants everything to stop being different. And Da Khuyet will be there, standing beside it.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.msg: Open the Gate of the Primordial Void and defeat Primordial Oblivion.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5_end.p1: Go. Whatever you choose, I will be here.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_seal.p1: You sealed it. I can see the light returning to the rooftops.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_seal.p2: But a seal needs a guardian. And I have a feeling this is not finished.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_absorb.p1: You swallowed it. Everyone out there looks at you, and they are afraid.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_absorb.p2: I am not afraid. But I will not pretend you are the same as before.

hukhong.flow.pro.city.title: Night of the Void
hukhong.flow.pro.city.l1: The alarm bells ring across the city. Purple-black Hư Thi pour in through the east gate.
hukhong.flow.pro.city.l2: You grip your weapon. This is no longer a legend.
hukhong.flow.pro.city.l3: Goal: cut down the Hư Thi before they reach the houses.
hukhong.flow.pro.sect.title: First Task
hukhong.flow.pro.sect.l1: Your master stands beneath the Spirit Qi Platform, eyes heavy as stone.
hukhong.flow.pro.sect.l2: Outer disciples have gone missing lately. Your master needs a disciple brave enough to go.
hukhong.flow.pro.sect.l3: Hear your master out before leaving the mountain.
hukhong.flow.pro.village.title: The Night the Village Forgot
hukhong.flow.pro.village.l1: The livestock stand still, staring at the sky; then the well turns black. Hư Thi crawl out of the dark.
hukhong.flow.pro.village.l2: Nobody taught you to fight, but you cannot run while others are still here.
hukhong.flow.pro.village.l3: Goal: hold on until the Hư Thi fall, then take the road to the city.
hukhong.flow.ch.1.title: Chapter 1: Specks of Dust
hukhong.flow.ch.1.l1: Mộ Dao: "You have stood before the Soul-Seal Altar. From now on, spirit qi knows your name."
hukhong.flow.ch.1.l2: Mộ Dao: "The Void is not evil. It is only hungry. And hunger devours everything that is different."
hukhong.flow.ch.1.l3: Train to level 10, then return to the altar to choose a Core.
hukhong.flow.ch.2.title: Chapter 2: Entering the Way
hukhong.flow.ch.2.l1: Mộ Dao: "Broken through already? Then it is time to choose a roof over your head - a sect."
hukhong.flow.ch.2.l2: Mộ Dao: "They say a self-proclaimed genius waits at Hắc Thạch Quan. His name is Hạng Chiêu."
hukhong.flow.ch.2.l3: A Hư Tu cut down recently wore a sect token. Something is wrong.
hukhong.flow.ch.3.title: Chapter 3: The First Secret Realm
hukhong.flow.ch.3.l1: Mộ Dao: "Cổ Tiên Thành stands on the ruins of the Nine Gods. Its Secret Realms feed the greedy and the brave alike."
hukhong.flow.ch.3.l2: Mộ Dao: "The Envoys mark their wrists with a crescent moon. If you see one, do not turn your back."
hukhong.flow.ch.3.l3: Their Dossiers are the thread that leads back to whoever stands behind them.
hukhong.flow.ch.4.title: Chapter 4: Shadow of Night
hukhong.flow.ch.4.l1: Mộ Dao: "From here on, trust no one merely because their face is familiar."
hukhong.flow.ch.4.l2: Mộ Dao: "An old archivist at Cổ Tiên Thành knows more than he says - Hứa Cổ."
hukhong.flow.ch.4.l3: Hunt the masked, gather Dossiers, then find Hứa Cổ.
hukhong.flow.ch.5.title: Chapter 5: The Stolen Fortune
hukhong.flow.ch.5.l1: Mộ Dao: "Lưu Ly Cảng is restless again. The market is too loud, as if someone wants to hide another sound."
hukhong.flow.ch.5.l2: Mộ Dao: "Defend this city - and watch for the one who already got ahead of you once."
hukhong.flow.ch.5.l3: Hạng Chiêu will not let a fortune sit quietly in anyone else's hands.
hukhong.flow.ch.6.title: Chapter 6: The Earth Gate
hukhong.flow.ch.6.l1: Mộ Dao: "The Dossiers point to a lair. The first Executor guards a Shard of the Heaven Gate."
hukhong.flow.ch.6.l2: Mộ Dao: "I... have something to tell you, once you have seen that lair."
hukhong.flow.ch.6.l3: Gather enough Dossiers to reveal a lair, then meet Mộ Dao.
hukhong.flow.ch.7.title: Chapter 7: Thạch Hống
hukhong.flow.ch.7.l1: Mộ Dao: "Thạch Hống was once a chieftain who held back the Void with his body. The copy still believes he guards his tribe."
hukhong.flow.ch.7.l2: Mộ Dao: "You will have to fight someone worthy of respect. Do not forget he was deceived."
hukhong.flow.ch.7.l3: Reach the Viêm Sơn Wastes and defeat Executor I.
hukhong.flow.ch.8.title: Chapter 8: Compassion
hukhong.flow.ch.8.l1: Mộ Dao: "Kim Sa lies to the west. Bạch Từ Âm will not kill you - she only wants your pain to end."
hukhong.flow.ch.8.l2: Mộ Dao: "Word is that Hạng Chiêu went that way. Do not let her lull him to sleep."
hukhong.flow.ch.8.l3: Find Hạng Chiêu on the road, then defeat Executor II.
hukhong.flow.ch.9.title: Chapter 9: Sword Lost
hukhong.flow.ch.9.l1: Mộ Dao: "Tuyết Kiếm Lĩnh. Lăng Uyên knows he is a copy and still chooses to stand there."
hukhong.flow.ch.9.l2: Mộ Dao: "Before you go, I have one last word."
hukhong.flow.ch.9.l3: Defeat Executor III, then return to Mộ Dao.
hukhong.flow.ch.10.title: Chapter 10: The Trial
hukhong.flow.ch.10.l1: A crescent moon rises on the water. "The cracked night will be whole again."
hukhong.flow.ch.10.l2: Dạ Khuyết knows your name now. Only one Executor stands before the final door.
hukhong.flow.ch.10.l3: Defeat Cơ Vô Tận, join the four Gate Shards, and enter the Trial.
hukhong.flow.end.title: Epilogue
hukhong.flow.end.l1: The door is shut or open - the choice was yours alone.
hukhong.flow.end.l2: Hạng Chiêu, Mộ Dao, Hứa Cổ: each one has a road of their own left to walk.
hukhong.flow.end.l3: The world remains for you to explore.

hukhong.flow.invasion.ruin: The city has fallen. Retake it: clear the Hollow horde around the city, then hold the city heart to cleanse it; the story resumes afterwards.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.pro_meet.p1: Hey! You are hurt. I am Mộ Dao, a Dao cultivator bound for Lưu Ly Cảng.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.pro_meet.p2: I saw the purple thread on those creatures. So the Void has reached even here...
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.pro_meet.p3: The city has a Soul-Seal Altar. You need it. Spirit qi will not know you until your name is carved there.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.pro_meet.c1: Thank you. Lead me to the altar.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.pro_meet_end.p1: Let us go. I will walk with you a while - losing a name does not hurt, but I would rather not try.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_leave.p1: You trusted me this whole road. I am sorry I hid it - my parents were Envoys.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_leave.p2: Because you trusted me, I dared to find myself. At Tuyết Kiếm Lĩnh I saved you once, and I do not regret it.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_leave.p3: I must go. Some things in the old Dạ Điện only I can close.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_leave_end.p1: Mộ Dao leaves, a protective charm resting on the table.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_sacrifice.p1: You still doubt me, and I understand. My parents were Envoys - I lived in the Dạ Điện as a child.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_sacrifice.p2: In the last battle I read the rhythm of the Envoys. Only I can hold them at the narrow pass.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_sacrifice.p3: Do not come back for me. Keep going.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch9_sacrifice_end.p1: Mộ Dao smiles and turns her back toward the closing gate.
hukhong.dlg.su_phu.task.p1: You are here. Outer disciples on patrol have not returned lately, marked with purple.
hukhong.dlg.su_phu.task.p2: First task: meditate at the Spirit Qi Platform to settle your mind, then slay five Hư Thi lurking around the sect.
hukhong.dlg.su_phu.task.p3: When done, go to Lưu Ly Cảng. The sect cannot bear this alone; the city must know.
hukhong.dlg.su_phu.task_end.p1: Go. Keep hold of your name.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c5.p1: We meet again. I took the fortune in that Secret Realm first - you were a step too late.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c5.p2: The world only remembers the last one standing. I intend to be that one.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c5.p3: Do not worry, I will not kill you. Only remind you who is stronger.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c5.c2: Wait. Have you heard whispers lately?
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c5_lore.p1: ...You hear them too? I thought it was only me.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c8.p1: That light... it is so warm. She said I never need to be stronger than anyone again.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c8.p2: You... are the one I used to hate. Why do you look like you are in pain?
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c8.p3: Step aside. She says you will hurt me again.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c8.c1: I will wake you up, even with my fists.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.c8.c2: If you choose them, I will not stop you.

hukhong.dlg.thuong_nhan.offer.p1: Hero! I carry a cart of spirit herbs out of town and the roads are unsafe.
hukhong.dlg.thuong_nhan.offer.p2: Escort me about 100 blocks and I will pay well.
hukhong.dlg.thuong_nhan_e.walking.p1: Let us go - and do not fall behind!
hukhong.dlg.thuong_nhan_e.post.p1: Heavens... the guards I hired in the city were Sứ Đồ? I had no idea!
hukhong.dlg.thuong_nhan_e.post.p2: One of them still breathes. What will you do?
hukhong.dlg.thuong_nhan_e.arrive.p1: We made it! Thanks to you my cargo and my life are intact.
hukhong.dlg.lam_thu.again.p1: Please hurry to that village; my junior cannot wait long.
hukhong.dlg.lam_thu.offer.p1: My junior passed a village out there and vanished. They say it has been corrupted.
hukhong.dlg.lam_thu.offer.p2: Could you go and find him for me?
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.guard.p1: They are coming again! Do not let them touch me!
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.choice.p1: It is you... Did Senior Sister Lâm send you? The void qi has eaten half of me.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.choice.p2: I took this from a Sứ Đồ corpse in the village. Take it.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.choice.p3: You can guard me through a second surge, or leave me to my fate.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.thanks.p1: I live... thanks to you. The void qi recedes.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.thanks.p2: This Document belonged to the Sứ Đồ; let me give it to you.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_lac.thanks.c1: Take the Document and wish him well.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_mat.again.p1: Keep what I gave you hidden. When you are strong enough, confront him.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_mat.offer.p1: Shh. I saw Elder Mạc Tùng secretly meeting Dạ Khuyết's people.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_mat.offer.p2: I stole a Document from him. I dare not keep it.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_mat.offer.p3: When you are strong enough he will seek you out. Then decide for yourself.
hukhong.dlg.de_tu_mat.offer.c2: I want no part in this.
hukhong.dlg.truong_lao_gian.confront.p1: I hear you carry a Document one of my disciples stole.
hukhong.dlg.truong_lao_gian.confront.p2: Yes, I work for Dạ Khuyết. He promised my sect would survive the corruption.
hukhong.dlg.truong_lao_gian.confront.c1: Expose you before the whole sect.
hukhong.dlg.truong_lao_gian.confront.c2: Expose you - with proof from the Sứ Đồ guard.
hukhong.dlg.truong_lao_gian.confront.c3: Blackmail: give me what I need and I stay silent.
hukhong.dlg.tu_si_hap_hoi.again.p1: The cave... where the map points...
hukhong.dlg.tu_si_hap_hoi.offer.p1: Cough... I will not last. This is a map fragment to a cave no one knows.
hukhong.dlg.tu_si_hap_hoi.offer.p2: Go there. Return what you find to my family, or keep it... as you wish.
hukhong.dlg.tu_si_hap_hoi.offer.c1: I will pass it on to your family.
hukhong.dlg.tu_si_hap_hoi.offer.c2: I will keep whatever is in the cave.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_merchant.p1: I hear Sứ Đồ are disguising themselves as merchant guards. They have crept deeper than I thought.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_disciple_saved.p1: You protected that disciple from the Hư Thi? Good. Their sect will remember you.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_disciple_abandon.p: You left a half-corrupted disciple behind... I understand, but do not forget it.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_expose.p1: You exposed the elder informant. Dạ Khuyết has lost a major pawn.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_blackmail.p1: I hear you blackmailed an elder. Be careful - those pressed will bite back.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_keep.p1: You kept what lay in a dying man's hidden cave? Greedy, but I will not judge.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.qc_deliver.p1: You carried a dead man's legacy to his family. Rare in these times.

hukhong.story.doc.a7: Troop order: three Ma Tu squads must lie in wait around the Human-tier cities before the eclipse night. Kill no one yet; the moon needs the living to watch.
hukhong.story.doc.a8: Moon ledger: with each waning moon the Void grows another ring. Where the eclipse goes unanswered, the dark thickens.
hukhong.story.doc.a9: Secret letter: the Earth Gate opens not by force but by consent. The Shard-bearer must step through willingly, not knowing where.
hukhong.story.doc.a10: Last will of a Shadow Line agent: "If you read this, I am dead. Da Khuyet no longer gives orders in his old voice. Something inside him is begging for help."
hukhong.story.doc.b7: The Saintess's clinic book: the infected do not go mad, they go silent. She wrote: "Silence is a symptom, not a cure."
item.hukhong.van_kien_b8: Document B8: Letter to Mo Dao
hukhong.story.doc.b8: An unfinished letter to Mo Dao: "Trust no one in the temple, not even me. If I start speaking like them, run."
hukhong.story.doc.b9: Minutes of a closed meeting: three people inside the Sect draw pay from the Apostles. Their names are in fading ink, legible only under a waning moon.
hukhong.story.doc.b10: Last page of an Apostle's diary: "I remember now. I was a Sect disciple. No one took me; I walked into the dark because I was so tired."
hukhong.story.doc.c1: Ancient carving: "Before the Void there was one who stood between two worlds. He was called the Guardian."
hukhong.story.doc.c2: Oath carved on a stele: "I vow to be the vessel, to take into myself what the world cannot bear, that those after may still see the sun." The signature is Da Khuyet's.
hukhong.story.doc.c3: The Guardian had four disciples. Each was given one Shard of the seal to watch, and told: "If your master changes, do not hate him."
item.hukhong.van_kien_c4: Legacy Letter C4: Where the Void Came From
hukhong.story.doc.c4: The Void is no outside enemy. It is the loss the world gathered over a thousand years of war, taking shape once full.
item.hukhong.van_kien_c5: Legacy Letter C5: Day of Sealing
hukhong.story.doc.c5: On the day of sealing, the sky stayed dark three days. The Guardian stepped into the circle and did not come out. What came out later bore another name.
hukhong.story.doc.c6: Final notes: the vessel will crack after a thousand years. Without a successor, the Void will burst on its own and swallow the world in one night.
item.hukhong.van_kien_c7: Legacy Letter C7: Why the Gate Opened
hukhong.story.doc.c7: A disciple wrote: "Master does not wish to open the Void to destroy. He seeks someone strong enough to take his place before he is spent."
item.hukhong.van_kien_c8: Legacy Letter C8: Two Old Roads
hukhong.story.doc.c8: The two old ways: seal again and prolong the suffering a thousand years, or absorb it and make one person the new vessel. No one thought of a third.
item.hukhong.van_kien_c9: Legacy Letter C9: The Third Way
hukhong.story.doc.c9: A half-torn page: "The Void is loss. Loss cannot be caged, only seen off. It takes four Shards held together, and one who stays within the storm."
hukhong.story.doc.c10: Da Khuyet's last message to whoever comes after: "If you read this, do not strike at once. Speak with me first. I have waited so long."

hukhong.boss.sub.hu_vuong.2.1: This crown never held me. It only held my name.
hukhong.boss.sub.hu_vuong.2.2: The Void does not come from outside. It was always inside you, inside me, inside every grain of earth.
hukhong.boss.sub.hu_vuong.3.1: This heaven and earth... let it be empty.
hukhong.boss.sub.hu_vuong.3.2: I devour you first, then the light you carry.
hukhong.boss.sub.sa_hat_vuong.2.1: This sand was once my bones. Come down... let the sand claim you.
hukhong.boss.sub.sa_hat_vuong.3.1: Even the last grain of sand has learned to hate.
hukhong.boss.sub.sa_hat_vuong.3.2: Let the storm rise. We shall see who still stands.
hukhong.boss.sub.bang_nhan.2.1: Ice does not melt. Only trespassers do.
hukhong.boss.sub.bang_nhan.3.1: A thousand years of snow... and I still remember someone calling my name.
hukhong.boss.sub.bang_nhan.3.2: No one calls now. Then let everything freeze.
hukhong.boss.sub.doc_mau.2.1: My children... hatch and feast on the intruder.
hukhong.boss.sub.doc_mau.3.1: Venom is the breath of this swamp. Every breath you take feeds me.
hukhong.boss.sub.doc_mau.3.2: Climb higher. The mist is still rising.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_1.2.1: My master told me to keep the stone unbroken. I shall — by crushing you.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_1.3.1: This roar is the vow of one who guards the gate.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_1.3.2: Which gate? You are not yet worthy to know.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_2.2.1: A merciful voice does not save the listener. It only lulls them to sleep.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_2.3.1: My master once said: too much light is its own kind of dark.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_2.3.2: Close your eyes. I will not let you see what he bears.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_3.2.1: My blade has never touched the bottom of the abyss. Care to try?
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_3.3.1: The abyss looks back at you. And below, someone stands guard.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_3.3.2: With this single stroke, I take back my master's share.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_4.2.1: Hungry. Since my master sealed the Void, hunger is all I know.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_4.3.1: Give me a little more life. I have waited so long.
hukhong.boss.sub.chg_4.3.2: Do not fear. This sea of blood is also a way to remain.
hukhong.boss.sub.da_khuyet.2.1: The moon has waned by half. As have I, since the day I closed that door.
hukhong.boss.sub.da_khuyet.2.2: You ask what I am holding? A true question — and one I cannot answer.
hukhong.boss.sub.da_khuyet.3.1: The time has come. You are about to see what I carry within.
hukhong.boss.sub.da_khuyet.3.2: Do not rush to call it an enemy. Nor to call it a friend.
hukhong.boss.sub.da_khuyet.3.3: Beneath this blood moon, show me what you will choose.
hukhong.boss.sub.liberation.1: The corruption recedes like a tide. For the first time in years, this land can breathe.
hukhong.boss.sub.liberation.2: The violet sky fades. Light returns.
